- bul_unify_005: Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths feeding vector services.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a disciplined operating model.
